summary: Explore the Skyglider Skip-Count Run activity: try the 'Show me' demo, attempt an incorrect answer to see recovery feedback, then choose the correct answer to test successful progression, and observe completion state.

actions.reason: See what the demo/tutorial shows before attempting the problem myself
Allow demo animation to play out
Switch to interactive mode to attempt the problem
Deliberately pick an incorrect answer (16 breaks the skip-count-by-5 pattern) to see how the app handles wrong answers
Wait for any feedback animation or message after wrong answer
Select the correct answer (20 continues the skip count by 5s) to test successful completion
Allow success animation/feedback to fully render
